next_action.command: If active-run exists, run status. If this is the source Mac, initialize a new run. If this is a fresh post-erase Mac, resume the remote run with its independently stored manifest digest. Ask the human which case applies when runtime state is absent.

invariants: Generated run.json and receipts, not this router, hold live execution state.
Never erase, delete, or overwrite restored data without explicit human approval.
Never overwrite the fresh dotfiles clone from a projects archive.
Reauthenticate by default; do not restore old tokens.
The current home must match the authenticated manifest target before restore.
